name: Mailchimp
whatYouLose: Deliverability expertise and shared sending infrastructure
Complex automation journeys and audience segmentation
Compliance tooling, reputation monitoring and support
prompt: Build an email newsletter manager for up to 10,000 subscribers. Include double opt-in forms, lists and tags, a block-light HTML editor, test sends, campaign scheduling, unsubscribe handling, bounce and complaint webhooks, basic open and click analytics, CSV import/export and a public archive. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript and SQLite. Send through a configurable transactional email provider and enforce consent and suppression rules server-side.
notes: You can own the interface and subscriber data. You should still rent the email delivery infrastructure unless operating mail servers is your hobby.
